notes.title: Cozyrama demo update 0.2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/fbe605b13a2636dd7279f45a50b209297693b8a5.png"]

In this update:

- Ability to change the shape of the diorama

- Screenshot tool fixes

- Buttons in the radial menu no longer appear pressed

- Water detection is now much more accurate (placing decorations near water should work fine!)

- Performance improvements

- Duplication bug fixed

- Camera limits improved

- Every color icon now matches its color

- Fox and squirrel can no longer drown (lily pads now appear under their feet)

- Tools on controller now have sounds

- Small decorations no longer swing wildly

- Deleting decorations with the Del key now has a sound

- Added European French and European Spanish

- Added more keyboard shortcuts to make playing on a touchpad easier (you can scale and rotate decorations with the arrow keys)

- New scenes now start empty, with no grass and no road

- Added snakes!

Thanks for trying out the demo! 🩷

notes.title: Cozyrama demo update 0.1
notes.notes:
Changelog:

- Fixed rooster swim animation (he is no longer moonwalking!)

- Carpet no longer buries itself under paths

- You can now add spaces in diorama names

- Swing no longer causes issues

- Added the ability to move the camera up and down! (Up/Down arrows on keyboard, L1/R1 on gamepad)

- Added more navigation hints to make camera control easier

- A few minor bug fixes

- Changed game icon to match the steam one
